grammar.title: by bus, by plane
explain: Use by + transport to say HOW you travel.
I go to school by bus. She travels by plane.
But we say on foot when we walk: I go to the park on foot.
examples: I travel to school by bus.
They go to Dubai by plane.
We cross the creek by boat.
My friend walks to school. She goes on foot.

practice.prompt: We travel by ___ across the lake.
I walk to the park. I go ___ foot.

practice.answer: They travel by train to the mall.

grammar.title: flies, drives, rides
explain: Different transport has different action words.
A pilot flies a plane. A driver drives a car, taxi or bus. You ride a bike or a motorbike.
With he, she or one person, add -s: he drives. fly → flies.
examples: The boat sails across the sea.

practice.prompt: The pilot ___ the plane over the sea.

practice.explain: y after a consonant changes to ies: fly → flies.

practice.prompt: We say: The pilot drives the plane.

grammar.title: and, but, so
explain: Join two ideas with and, but or so.
and = more. but = different. so = because of that.
The train is fast and it is clean. / The bus is slow but it is cheap. / It was raining so we took a taxi.
examples: Minji likes the train and she likes the taxi.
The plane is fast but it is expensive.
The family was hungry so they ordered food.

practice.prompt: The family was hungry ___ they ordered food.
The metro is fast ___ it is clean.
The bus is slow ___ it is cheap.
Minji waves at the children ___ they wave back.
It was very hot ___ we took a taxi.

practice.answer: The plane is fast but the boat is slow.

reading.title: Hamdan Visits Grandma
paragraphs: On Saturday, Hamdan and his dad visit Grandma in Old Dubai. Dad doesn't take the car, so they go by metro.
The metro is fast and clean. It goes through tunnels and over bridges. Hamdan looks out of the window and sees tall buildings and busy roads.
Next, they cross the creek by abra. An abra is a small wooden boat. The wind is cool and Hamdan sees birds over the water. "This is my favourite part!" he says.
Grandma's house is near the creek, so they walk there on foot. Grandma is waiting at the door. "How did you come?" she asks. "By train, by boat and on foot!" Hamdan laughs.

questions.prompt: Why do they go by metro?
They take a taxi to Grandma's house.
How many kinds of transport do they use?

items: They cross the creek by abra.
Grandma is waiting at the door.
